beats.narration_text: Liam, in for Bear — part two of the Bear Brown logo. Four transforms: scale zoom linear then bezier, rotation with a spring pivot and a slow hold, a skew-and-shear lean to eighteen degrees, and a blur entrance — eighteen pixels clearing to zero. Every one of them is interpolate plus an easing curve.

Your turn. Paste this: skew my logo to eighteen degrees, hold it there for a beat, then release back to vertical — and tell me whether the lean reads as italic or as unstable. That's a brand question, not a code question.
Bear Brown logo, in motion. Part two. Liam, in for Bear.
